articles.summary: B&W announced today that it has recently secured awards of more than $21 million for fuel switching technologies in the United States reflecting the increased utilization of coal and natural gas power plants. This increased demand for power is also driving continued strong performance in the Company’s parts and services business.
articles.title: Babcock & Wilcox Secures $21 Million for Fuel Switching Technology Awards; Parts and Services Continues Strong Performance Driven by Increased Baseload Demand

articles.summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. (NYSE:BW) (B&W or the “Company”) will host a conference call and webcast on Monday, May 11, 2026 at 5 p.m. ET.
articles.title: Babcock & Wilcox Sets First Quarter 2026 Conference Call and Webcast for Monday, May 11, 2026 at 5 p.m. ET
